extracted.intended_audience: Investigators/Researchers preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications (PIs, co-investigators, key personnel)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare an NIH-formatted biographical sketch for a grant application, including the required header, Education/Training table, Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contributions to Science, and Research Support sections within the five-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The entire biographical sketch (all sections combined) must fit within five pages. Concise presentation is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Header fields (identification)
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login); POSITION TITLE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide your full name, eRA Commons user name, and current position title exactly as requested in the form header.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table fields
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.) — INSTITUTION AND LOCATION; DEGREE; Completion Date MM/YYYY; FIELD OF STUDY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List education and training entries starting from the baccalaureate. For each entry include institution and location, degree, completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study. Include postdoctoral/residency training where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement section that summarizes current role, research focus, relevant experience, and the applicant's specific role/contributions to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe your current position and research focus, list prior relevant experience and responsibilities, state how you will contribute to the proposed project (e.g., roles on aims, collaborations, specific tasks), and mention mentoring or leadership responsibilities when relevant. Keep this focused and tied to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Employment
rubrics_metrics.description: Chronological list of positions and employment (dates and titles), adjunct/secondary appointments, and institutional affiliations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide date ranges and titles for prior and current academic/employment positions. Include adjunct appointments and leadership roles (e.g., Vice Chair). This section can also include brief notes on institutional roles relevant to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Honors and professional service
rubrics_metrics.description: List of honors, awards, editorial board memberships, and standing service (e.g., NIH study section membership).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include notable awards with years, editorial board memberships, and service on review panels or professional organizations that demonstrate standing in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Numbered narrative descriptions of up to several major contributions to science, each followed by representative citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each numbered contribution: provide a concise paragraph describing the contribution and its significance, followed by lettered citations of representative publications (including journal, year, and identifiers when available). Focus on recent/most relevant work and how it relates to the applicant's expertise for the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Representative publications / citation identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide representative publications under each Contribution to Science item, often including PMCID/PMID when available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite key papers that substantiate the described contributions. Include PMCID or PMID numbers or DOI where available to facilitate verification and access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete list of published work (MyBibliography link)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography (provide URL or link to the MyNCBI/MyBibliography collection).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a link (e.g., to your MyBibliography/MyNCBI collection) listing all publications to complement the selected representative citations in section C.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Ongoing and completed research support entries listing grant number, sponsor, project title/short description, role (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator), and project dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate ongoing vs. completed support. For each item provide the grant ID, funding agency, project title or short description of aims, the applicant’s role on the grant, and start/end dates. Indicate how the support is relevant to the current application when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role specification in research support
rubrics_metrics.description: State the applicant's role on each listed project (e.g., Principal Investigator, Co-Investigator, Subcontract Principal Investigator).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly indicate responsibilities and leadership (PI/Co-PI) so reviewers can assess the applicant's level of independence and relevance to the proposed work.
